name: @mieweb/deploy-wrangler
description: The Cloudflare reference implementation of the @mieweb/deploy-contract `DeployProvider`. Wraps the project's own `wrangler` (install it in your project): `deploy`/`dev`/`tail` delegate verbatim so Cloudflare behavior is identical, and resource handles are read back from the wrangler.jsonc manifest. This is the canonical provider every other deploy backend (opensource-server, future AWS/GCP) is measured against via the contract's conformance test-kit.
author: MIEWEB
